notes:
0.14.0.0
- Voice chat works for players who join a lobby over the internet (they could neither be heard nor hear before), on Windows and Linux.
- Esc > Options > Voice: choose your microphone and your output device (headphones or speakers). The old Microphone row is now "Send voice".
- Esc > Options > Audio: "Sound in the background" On / Off.
- Options are split into tabs (Graphics, Audio, Voice, Key bindings, Interface), each with its own reset; a text size slider.
- The music player ships with three songs, remembers where it stopped, goes up to 200 % volume and has a new look ([L]).
- Campaign XP: every mission pays 15, doubled for the Campaign, times the time of day. Standard runs are capped at 10 missions.
- The lobby's exit door is a real door, with a military outpost outside.
- The city has flower pots and window boxes on some houses.
- Interacting (F) prefers mission objects and downed teammates over cars and items nearby.
